ja: キャラクターの魅力をオリジナルアレンジで“増幅”！『遊☆戯☆王デュエルモンスターズ』より、三幻神の一体「ラーの翼神竜」がAmplifiedに降臨!!
• 翼を前面に展開することで、Amplified解釈の球体形（スフィア・モード）を再現。
• 額の宝玉や舌などを洗練されたパーツ分割で表現。設定をイメージした緻密な色分けを実現。
• 2色のゴールドパーツの使い分けでディテールを再現。
• 細かく可動部分を設け、柔軟な可動を実現。口の開閉、舌の可動が可能。
• 翼の全幅約400mmで迫力のある飛翔姿を再現。
• ディスプレイベースと2種類のディスプレイベース用ジョイントパーツが付属。
en: "Amplify" the charm of the character with an original arrangement! From "Yu-Gi-Oh!", one of the three phantom gods, "Ra's Winged Divine Dragon", descends on Amplified!
• By expanding the wings to the front, the spherical shape (sphere mode) of the Amplified interpretation is reproduced.
• Expresses the jewels and tongue on the forehead by sophisticated parts division. Precise color coding based on the image of the setting is realized.
• Reproduce the details by using two colors of gold parts properly.
• Finely movable parts are provided to realize flexible movement. It is possible to open and close the mouth and move the tongue.
• The total width of the wings is about 400 mm, and the powerful flight figure is reproduced.
• Comes with a display base and two types of joint parts for the display base.
